title: Trump expands tech crackdown on China imports to humanoid robots
excerpt: Trump banned new imports of Chinese humanoid robots and power inverters used in data centers to protect the domestic AI supply chain.
content_html:
The Trump administration has banned imports of new Chinese humanoid robots and power inverters

By Katherine Li

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The Trump administration is expanding its tech crackdown on China.

The Federal Communications Commission announced new restrictions on Tuesday targeting imports of advanced Chinese robots and power inverters, as part of a broader push to secure the domestic AI supply chain.

According to the FCC, the measure would ban imports of new Chinese-made humanoid and quadruped robots, as well as connected power inverters used in renewable energy systems, batteries, and data centers.

The FCC wrote in a public statement that these moves are the result of an interagency national security panel assembled by the White House, which convened to make two National Security Determinations.

"Inverters' remote connectivity introduces additional vulnerabilities which compound as inverter-based resources proliferate on the U.S. grid," the panel wrote in the National Security Determinations. "These vulnerabilities could enable foreign firms to turn off the inverters or use them to collect and exfiltrate data."

"Advanced robotic devices collect data that could be leveraged by malign actors to surveil Americans, enhance the capabilities of foreign intelligence services, or to remotely commandeer the robots," the panel added.

John Moolenaar, Republican chairman of the House Select Committee on China, applauded the FCC's move and urged Congress to further the policy and codify it into a federal law.

"It is likely that one day robotic technology will be in Americans' homes and workplaces, and we must protect our country by keeping out Chinese robots with backdoors that share sensitive data with the CCP," Moolenaar said in a statement.

The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

content_html_zh:
特朗普政府禁止进口中国新型人形机器人和电源逆变器

作者：Katherine Li 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

特朗普政府正在扩大对中国的科技打压。

美国联邦通信委员会周二宣布了针对先进中国机器人和逆变器进口的新限制，作为更广泛推动确保国内人工智能供应链安全的一部分。

据美国联邦通信委员会称，该措施将禁止进口新型中国制造的人形机器人和四足机器人，以及用于可再生能源系统、电池和数据中心的联网电源逆变器。

美国联邦通信委员会在一份公开声明中写道，这些举措是白宫组建的跨部门国家安全小组的结果，该小组开会做出了两项国家安全决定。

该小组在《国家安全决定》中写道：“逆变器的远程连接引入了额外的漏洞，随着美国电网上基于逆变器的资源激增，这些漏洞变得更加复杂。” “这些漏洞可能使外国公司能够关闭逆变器或利用它们来收集和窃取数据。”

该小组补充说：“先进的机器人设备收集的数据可能被恶意行为者用来监视美国人、增强外国情报部门的能力或远程征用机器人。”

众议院中国问题特别委员会共和党主席约翰·穆勒纳尔 (John Moolenaar) 对 FCC 的举措表示赞赏，并敦促国会进一步推进该政策并将其编入联邦法律。

穆勒纳尔在一份声明中表示：“有一天，机器人技术可能会进入美国人的家庭和工作场所，我们必须将带有后门、与中共共享敏感数据的中国机器人拒之门外，以保护我们的国家。”

中国驻华盛顿大使馆没有立即回应置评请求。
